build.title: Banner settings Apply to all pane + keys re-checked while the console is open

said.text: Apply to all tick box (axf.banners.applyAll) in the shared BannerSettings: ticked opens every setting once (set on every banner, Mixed when they differ) with each banner's own settings wrapped and named, and folds the per-banner tabs into one Each banner wrapper. Systems check re-tests keys on focus (once a minute) and every 5 min while visible. Built on Opus, branch claude/banner-apply-all-keys-recheck.
